title: Stop hand-copying private lint-rule path helpers into test files; assert through the real rule only

evidence.quote:
bool _isBarrel(String importedFeature, String importedPath) {
  return importedPath == '$importedFeature.dart';

why: Because each rule's `_isWhitelisted`/`_isGenerated`/`_isBarrel`/`_featureOf` helper is private and static, the test authors copy-pasted a second implementation into the test file rather than exposing a testable seam (e.g. @visibleForTesting) or relying solely on the full testAnalyzeAndRun assertions the same files already have. If a rule's real whitelist changes (as F1b's recommended fix would do), the hand-copied test function has to be remembered and updated separately, or the 'whitelist — file path checks' group keeps passing while asserting stale behavior that no longer matches the shipped rule — a false sense of unit coverage on top of the genuine end-to-end tests in the same file.
recommendation: Delete the six _invoke*/_isBarrel/_featureOf copies and keep only the testAnalyzeAndRun-based violation/allowed groups (already present in every file and sufficient to exercise the same whitelist logic through the real code path).
acceptance_criteria: No custom_lints test file re-implements a rule's private path-matching logic; whitelist behavior is asserted only via rule.testAnalyzeAndRun.
dart test coverage of whitelist behavior is unchanged or improved after removal.
